title: Disbursement plan shows amounts in öre

articles.subject: Disbursement plan shows amounts in öre
articles.body:
Hi,

The disbursement plan view shows 25000000 where it should show 250 000 kr. The case itself and the decision letter are correct, it is only this view. It looks like a factor of 100.

Best,
Nina Dahl
Program officer, Ebbahus Stiftelse

articles.subject: Re: Disbursement plan shows amounts in öre
articles.body:
Hi Nina,

You are right, the plan view was missing the minor-unit conversion that the rest of the application does. Amounts are stored correctly, so nothing is wrong in your data or in the payments, only the display.

Fix goes out with Thursday's release.

Regards,
Jonas

articles.subject: Re: Disbursement plan shows amounts in öre
articles.body: Confirmed fixed after the release. Closing from my side.
